turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's it going? You doing okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My company gave me five hundred dollars for my home office, and I'm stuck on how to spend it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll describe them all, so please hold off until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a really good ergonomic chair, which would use up almost the whole budget.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a second monitor plus a nice keyboard and mouse.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a cheaper chair and a standing desk converter that sits on my current table.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or finally, noise cancelling headphones and a good webcam for all my calls.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The cheaper chair plus the standing desk converter gives you the most variety in posture for the money. The headphones and webcam only make sense if calls are a big part of your day.
